text:
Root cause: `_cached._wrapper` used `if not cache` to select the uncached wrapper. Newly created caches and empty dictionaries are falsey, so caching was disabled even when a valid cache object was supplied.

Changed the check to `if cache is None`, ensuring empty caches are used normally. All targeted tests pass: **74 passed**.

             wrapper = _unlocked_info(func, cache, key, info)

+        if cache is None:

final_text:
Root cause: `_cached._wrapper` used `if not cache` to select the uncached wrapper. Newly created caches and empty dictionaries are falsey, so caching was disabled even when a valid cache object was supplied.

Changed the check to `if cache is None`, ensuring empty caches are used normally. All targeted tests pass: **74 passed**.
